_comment: Repos with a production target. The deploy-watch routine polls each enabled repo's main on its venue (`venue`: github by default, read with `gh`; forgejo only for the `lastgit` repo); when the tip moved and its CI is green (GitHub: the ci-required check run) it runs the deploy-main Loom graph, which stages that exact OID and runs the repo's OWN deploy script with the same variables the retired launchd watchers gave it. `env` is copied into the deploy script's environment. `verify_command` runs after the deploy with DEPLOY_OID / DEPLOY_REPO set and must exit 0 (retried for up to 10 min). Disabled repos are listed so the retirement of their launchd agents is visible here, not only in launchd's override table. Every repo listed here is on GitHub (2026-09-29/30); they stay disabled because a per-repo GitHub poller is the deployer of record.

repos.verify_command: curl -fsS --max-time 20 https://thelastdb.com/llms.txt | grep -q 'LastDB' && curl -fsSI --max-time 20 https://thelastdb.com/ | grep -qi '^HTTP/[0-9.]* 200'
repos.notes: thelastdb.com via vercel promote (token lastsecrets://lastgit-vercel-token). The gate of record is GitHub EdgeVector/fold_db_website since 2026-09-30 (LastGit is retired, decision-2026-09-29-retire-lastgit-all-repos-to-github). deploy-watch can read GitHub now, but this entry stays disabled. The deployer of record is the per-repo GitHub poller that reads the ci-required check run on GitHub main (com.edgevector.github-deploy-fold-db-website, installed by Tom); the old com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-fold-db-website label is retired.

Exemem cloud pipeline. Production deploys use the LastSecrets-backed OBS_SENTRY_DSN locator at the deploy child boundary. The gate of record is GitHub EdgeVector/exemem-infra since 2026-09-30 (LastGit is retired). deploy-watch can read GitHub now, but this entry stays disabled. The old com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-exemem-infra label is retired; a production deploy stays a decision for Tom (sop-migrate-repo-to-github, exemem-infra section).

Schema service pipeline. The gate of record is GitHub EdgeVector/schema-infra since 2026-09-30 (LastGit is retired). deploy-watch can read GitHub now, but this entry stays disabled. The old com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-schema-infra and canary-ticker labels are retired (plists renamed .disabled-20260930); no deploy workflow is enabled on GitHub until Tom decides.

Local ops terminal. The gate of record is GitHub EdgeVector/ops-terminal since 2026-09-30 (LastGit is retired). deploy-watch can read GitHub now, but this entry stays disabled. The deployer of record is the GitHub poller in .lastgit/deploy-run.sh that reads the ci-required check run on GitHub main (installed by Tom).
